test_series_n_unique: test the Series.n_unique() method counts distinct values including nulls in a polars Series
test_dataframe_n_unique: test the DataFrame.n_unique() method counts unique rows in a polars DataFrame
test_n_unique_subsets: test the DataFrame.n_unique(subset=...) method counts unique combinations of column subsets or expressions
test_categorical_n_unique: test the Series.n_unique() method on Categorical dtype handles duplicates and nulls correctly
test_array_n_unique: test the Series.n_unique() method on Array dtype counts unique numpy array values in polars
